what_works: Software product hero leads with a clean three-feature triad ('Drag and Drop / Materials / Plus Surfaces') in a grid — translates directly to 'three services we do better than anyone' for a younger tech-savvy owner. Electric-blue CTA pops against neutral product imagery.
what_does_not_translate: SaaS pricing-tier section doesn't map to a contractor — replace with a service-tier card grid using the same composition rules.
type_observations: Modern geometric sans (Inter / Söhne) at consistent weight; monospace tags for technical specs — single-family discipline keeps it clean.
